title: Giga Pisar
shortDescription: Voice typing in any text field: speech to text on your phone, no cloud
fullDescription:
Giga Pisar turns speech into text in any app: messengers, mail, notes, the browser.

Hold the volume-down key or the floating button in a text field, say a phrase and let go. The text appears where the cursor is, with commas and periods.

Like in Telegram: slide the button up to the lock and keep talking hands-free for up to five minutes. Slide sideways to cancel.

Recognition runs on the phone with the open GigaAM model. Audio is not sent anywhere; the internet is needed only once, to download the model.

Optionally, connect the Brain: an AI model of your choice, with your own key, edits the text on command.

Also:
• floating button size and apps where it stays hidden;
• no button on the lock screen;
• paste without the clipboard if you prefer;
• Russian and English interface.

Pisar needs the microphone and an accessibility service: through it, it sees the focused text field and puts the text there. None of this is stored or sent anywhere.

Open source: github.com/moznoazachem/giga-pisar-android
